# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a potential security vulnerability in this project or on [tiedan.site](https://tiedan.site),  
please report it **privately**. Do **not** submit it as a public GitHub Issue.

### Preferred Methods
- **GitHub Security Advisories:** [https://github.com/tiedanGH/GuideHomepage/security/advisories](https://github.com/tiedanGH/GuideHomepage/security/advisories)
- **Email:** [tiedan0227@gmail.com](mailto:tiedan0227@gmail.com)

### Related Resources
- [Security Policy (HTML)](https://tiedan.site/security-policy.html)
- [Security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt)

Please do **not** publicly disclose vulnerabilities before they have been reviewed and fixed.
